items.statement: Describe the measures in the air handling system that achieve Grade A, B, C and D air in the designated classified areas.
items.quote: 18.3 | WHO TRS-961 ANNEXE-06 | Specify the steps taken in air handling system to achieve the Grade A, B, C and D of air as per designated classified areas.

items.statement: State the clean-up (recovery) time of Grade B and C zones measured from when personnel leave the room after operations end, and keep records that can be verified.
items.quote: 18.4 | Sch-M | Specify the recovery time of B & C zone from the time of personnel leaving the room after completion of operations and verify the records in this regard.

items.statement: Challenge filling operations with simulation trials, including sterile media fill, at the start and periodically afterwards.
items.quote: 18.5 | Sch-M | Specify whether filling operations are challenged initially and there after periodically by simulation trials including sterile media fill.

items.statement: Have a defined procedure for media fills with stated acceptance criteria.
items.quote: 18.6 | WHO TRS-961 ANNEXE-06 | Specify the procedure followed for medial fill and the acceptance criteria.

items.statement: Design media fill trials on worst-case conditions, covering all interventions and activities of normal operation as well as worst case.
items.quote: 18.7 | WHO TRS-961 ANNEXE-06 | Whether the medial fill trial is based on worst case situation taking into consideration all interventions, activities occurring during normal activity as well as worst case.

items.statement: Repeat process simulation tests at defined intervals and after any significant change to the HVAC system, equipment or process.
items.quote: 18.8 | WHO TRS-961 ANNEXE-06 | Whether simulation tests are repeated at defined intervals and after any significant modification to HVAC system, equipment or process.
items.condition: at defined intervals and after significant HVAC, equipment or process change

items.statement: State the air change rate in Grade A/B and Grade C areas.
items.quote: 18.9 | Sch-M | Specify the number of air changes in Grade A/B and Grade C areas.

items.statement: State the air velocity maintained in Grade A laminar air flow stations.
items.quote: 18.10 | Sch-M | Specify the air velocity maintained in Grade A Laminar Air Flow stations

items.statement: State the pressure differential maintained between areas of different environmental standards.
items.quote: 18.1 | Sch-M | Specify the differential pressure between areas of different environmental standards.

items.statement: State the type of manometer installed to measure and verify air pressure differentials.
items.quote: 18.1 | Sch-M | Specify type of manometer installed for measurement and verification of Air Pressure Differential.

items.statement: State the air classification of the final change room used to enter Grade A/B areas.
items.quote: 18.13 | WHO TRS-961 | Specify the air classification in final change room to enter A/B area.

items.statement: Describe how garments used in clean areas are cleaned and sterilised.
items.quote: 20.2 | WHO TRS-961 ANNEXE-06 | Specify how the garments used in clean areas are cleaned and sterilized.

items.statement: Have an SOP for sanitation of sterile processing facilities and identify the SOP numbers.
items.quote: 21.1 | Sch-M | Specify the SOP followed for sanitation of sterile processing facilities and mention the SOP nos.

items.statement: Confirm that staff who sanitise critical areas are specifically trained for that task.
items.quote: 21.2 | Sch-M | Specify whether employees carrying out the sanitation of critical areas are specially trained for this purpose.

items.statement: Keep training records (for sanitation staff) available for verification.
items.quote: 21.3 | Sch-M | Verify the training records.

items.statement: Identify the sanitising agent(s) in use.
items.quote: 21.4 | Sch-M | Specify the sanitizing agent/s used.

items.statement: Define the water quality used to prepare sanitising solutions.
items.quote: 21.5 | Sch-M | Specify the quality of water used for preparation of sanitising solution.

items.statement: Identify the disinfectant used for hand sprays.
items.quote: 21.6 | Sch-M | Specify the disinfectant used for hand sprays?

items.statement: Filter disinfectant solutions through a membrane into suitable sterile containers, or sterilise them, before use.
items.quote: 21.7 | Sch-M | Specify whether disinfectant solutions are filtered through membrane into suitable sterile containers or sterilized before use?

items.statement: Label diluted disinfectants with a 'use before' date based on microbiological establishment of their germicidal properties, with records available for verification.
items.quote: 21.8 | Sch-M | Specify whether the diluted disinfectants bear ‘use before’ labels based on microbiological establishment of their germicidal properties & verify the records

items.statement: State whether critical areas are fumigated and, if so, identify the fumigating agent and the concentration used.
items.quote: 21.9 | Sch-M | Specify whether fumigation is carried out in critical areas. If yes, specify fumigating agent and its conc. used.

items.statement: Where fumigation is done, have an SOP for it and identify the SOP numbers.
items.quote: 21.10 | Sch-M | Specify whether any SOP exist for the purpose of fumigation if so mentioned the SOP nos.
items.condition: if an SOP for fumigation exists

items.statement: Describe the cleaning procedure for critical areas.
items.quote: 21.1 | Sch-M | Specify the cleaning procedure of critical areas.

items.statement: Monitor particles in Grade A zones for the full duration of critical processing, including equipment assembly.
items.quote: 21.1 | WHO TRS-961 ANNEXE-06 | Specify whether particle monitoring in Grade A zones is undertaken for the full duration of critical processing including equipment assembly.

items.statement: Monitor particles in Grade B zones for the full duration of critical processing.
items.quote: 21.1 | WHO TRS-961 | Specify whether particle monitoring in Grade B zones is undertaken for the full duration of critical processing.

items.statement: Place the temperature probes used for control and/or recording at positions determined during validation and, where applicable, check them against a second independent probe in the same position.
items.quote: S.No | Reference || 27.2 | Sch-M | Whether the position of temperature probes used for controlling and / or recording determined during validation and (where applicable) been checked against a second independent temperature probe located in the same position
items.text_layer_differs: The text layer inserts '1 Building and premises:' and a '-' around the start of the 27.2 row, which the image does not show.

items.statement: Make the sterilisation temperature chart part of the batch record.
items.quote: S.No | Reference || 27.3 | Sch-M | Whether the chart forms a part of the batch record.

items.statement: Validate sterilisation cycles physically (not only with biological and chemical indicators).
items.quote: S.No | Reference || 27.4 | Sch-M | Whether sterilization cycle validated only by biological indicator and chemical indicators or physical validation is also carried out

items.statement: Determine separately for each load type the time allowed to reach the required temperature before sterilising time measurement starts.
items.quote: S.No | Reference || 27.5 | Sch-M | Whether the time allowed reaching the required temperature before commencing the measurement of sterilizing time, separately determined for each type of load.

items.statement: Take adequate precautions to protect the load during cooling after the high-temperature phase of a heat sterilisation cycle.
items.quote: S.No | Reference || 27.6 | Sch-M | Are adequate precautions taken to protect the load during cooling after it has gone through the high temperature phase of a heat sterilization cycle
items.condition: after high-temperature phase of heat sterilisation

items.statement: Sterilise any cooling fluid or gas that contacts the product.
items.quote: S.No | Reference || 27.7 | Sch-M | In case the cooling is affected with any fluid or gas in contact with the product , is it sterilized.
items.condition: if cooling fluid or gas contacts the product

items.statement: Fit the sterilising equipment's air inlets and outlets with bacteria-retaining filters.
items.quote: S.No | Reference || 27.8 | Sch-M | Whether the equipment air inlet and outlets been provided with bacteria retaining filters
